constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (assessment_id, owner_user_id) REFERENCES m2_assessments(id, owner_user_id)

CHECK ((((revoked_at IS NULL) AND (revoked_by IS NULL) AND (revoke_reason IS NULL)) OR ((revoked_at IS NOT NULL) AND (revoked_by IS NOT NULL) AND (revoke_reason IS NOT NULL) AND (length(btrim(revoke_reason)) > 0))))
FOREIGN KEY (m2_assessment_id, user_id) REFERENCES m2_assessments(id, owner_user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (revoked_by) REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (((revision >= 0) AND ((confirmed_revision IS NULL) OR ((confirmed_revision >= 0) AND (confirmed_revision <= revision)))))
FOREIGN KEY (owner_user_id) REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (confirmation_id, assessment_id, assessment_revision, owner_user_id) REFERENCES m2_confirmation_snapshots(id, assessment_id, assessment_revision, actor_user_id)

FOREIGN KEY (context_id, confirmation_id, assessment_id, assessment_revision, owner_user_id) REFERENCES m2_business_contexts(context_id, confirmation_id, assessment_id, assessment_revision, owner_user_id)
CHECK (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['PENDING'::character varying, 'HELD'::character varying, 'PERSISTED'::character varying, 'FAILED'::character varying])::text[])))
CHECK ((((packet_json -> 'permissions'::text) = '{"qg_execution": false, "qj_execution": false, "report_release": false, "report_admission": false}'::jsonb) IS TRUE))

CHECK (((((packet_json #>> '{identity,assessment_id}'::text[]) = (assessment_id)::text) AND ((packet_json #>> '{identity,owner_id}'::text[]) = (owner_user_id)::text) AND ((packet_json #>> '{confirmation,id}'::text[]) = (confirmation_id)::text) AND (((packet_json #>> '{confirmation,revision}'::text[]))::integer = assessment_revision) AND ((packet_json #>> '{confirmation,digest}'::text[]) = (snapshot_digest)::text) AND ((packet_json ->> 'schema_version'::text) = (schema_version)::text) AND ((packet_json ->> 'context_version'::text) = (builder_version)::text) AND ((packet_json #>> '{identity,tenant_id}'::text[]) = (tenant_id)::text) AND ((packet_json #>> '{concept,version}'::text[]) = (concept_version)::text) AND ((packet_json #>> '{access,scope,purpose}'::text[]) = (purpose)::text)) IS TRUE))
FOREIGN KEY (confirmation_id, assessment_id, assessment_revision, owner_user_id) REFERENCES m2_confirmation_snapshots(id, assessment_id, assessment_revision, actor_user_id)
CHECK (((length(TRIM(BOTH FROM rationale)) >= 1) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM rationale)) <= 1000)))
FOREIGN KEY (assessment_id, actor_user_id) REFERENCES m2_assessments(id, owner_user_id)
FOREIGN KEY (finding_id, assessment_id, assessment_revision) REFERENCES m2_bdj_findings(id, assessment_id, assessment_revision)
FOREIGN KEY (actor_user_id) REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (assessment_id, actor_user_id) REFERENCES m2_assessments(id, owner_user_id)
FOREIGN KEY (actor_user_id) REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (((length(TRIM(BOTH FROM broader_objective)) >= 1) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM broader_objective)) <= 1000)))
FOREIGN KEY (actor_user_id) REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (assessment_id, actor_user_id) REFERENCES m2_assessments(id, owner_user_id)
